findings.text: _interpolate_template is now dead in production - the change removed its only caller - so the private helper survives solely for its own tests in tests/llm/test_search_tools.py and should be deleted or its caller restored

the shared access template is emitted verbatim, so placeholders such as {accessor} reach the agent unresolved (after_booster.log shows "ok, rtn = db.{accessor}"); for single-member rows the copy-pasteable call now lives only in the "Accessors:" line

justifications.durability: the negative_control.log shows that removing the template collapse reddens the grouping assertion at tests/llm/test_signal_report_rows.py:39 (EXIT=1), so that assertion is a guard that fails on the regression it names; the rank-after-rerank assertion at line 65 passes a literal 7 and enumerated order would give 1, so it discriminates too.
justifications.evidence: golden_reports.log's own summary line (SUMMARY questions=22 failures=0) and REPORT_LINES=341/112 in baseline_booster.log and after_booster.log are the done_when's measure, recorded rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:291 leaves _interpolate_template defined with no production caller, and the template block at line 255 emits placeholders like {accessor} un-interpolated.

justifications.reuse: the nearest owner is the accessor numeric-templating helper at imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2219 (_accessor_to_source_key), which serves ingestion grouping rather than report display, so the formatter adds a display capability rather than forking that one.
